advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that seeds an open mcp-deploy-backoff window and a SECRETS_PATHS-only delta (parametrized over fetch-secrets.sh and ssm.tf) and asserts the tick reports 'mcp backoff active' / sets mcp_incomplete / does not advance deployed-sha, covering the changed backoff-active gate arm.
evidence: autodeploy.sh:886 `if mcp_backoff_active && mcp_delta; then` — changed from `changed_range "$mcp_deployed" "$TARGET" "$MCP_PATHS"`
autodeploy.sh:890 `if ! mcp_backoff_active && mcp_delta; then` — the only arm the new test exercises (box has no mcp-deploy-backoff seeded)
Commit message: 'call it from both mcp gate arms (backoff-active and backoff-clear) so a secrets-only delta is reported pending during a backoff window instead of being dropped'

test_mcp_backoff_throttles_only_mcp_and_lets_the_bot_deploy (line 1686) opens the backoff via _mcp_box_shared_change (an MCP_PATHS src/rebar delta at line 1702), not a SECRETS_PATHS-only delta, so it does not verify mcp_delta on the backoff-active arm

ABSENCE: no test seeds an open mcp-deploy-backoff window together with a commit touching only infra/terraform/ssm.tf or infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh and asserts 'mcp backoff active' is logged / mcp_incomplete set / deployed-sha not advanced
advisory.finding: The changed backoff-active mcp gate arm (autodeploy.sh line 886, `if mcp_backoff_active && mcp_delta`) is not covered for a secrets-only delta. The new test only drives the backoff-clear arm (line 890, box has no mcp-deploy-backoff file). A regression reverting only the backoff-active arm's `mcp_delta` back to `changed_range ... MCP_PATHS` would silently drop a secrets-only delta during an open backoff window (advancing deployed-sha, leaving mcp on stale secrets) with no failing test — yet the commit message states the fix must apply to BOTH arms 'so a secrets-only delta is reported pending during a backoff window instead of being dropped.'
scenarios: An mcp deploy previously failed (mcp-deploy-backoff window open) and a subsequent commit touches only infra/terraform/ssm.tf — a SECRETS_PATHS-only delta arriving during the backoff window
advisory.suggested_fix: Parametrize a new test (or extend the existing backoff-throttle test) to open the mcp backoff window and drive a secrets-only delta, asserting 'mcp backoff active' is logged and deployed-sha is not advanced for the secrets-only case.
